consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 9/5 show at Richfield Coliseum was a solid performance, particularly in the second set, which featured standout moments. While some felt the first set was short and average, others praised the energy and crowd interaction throughout the night.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.1 for 14 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans enjoyed the show and highlighted specific songs, there were also criticisms regarding the first set and overall performance compared to the previous night.
